title: Add comprehensive logging to orchestrate
body:
## Background

The orchestrate loop currently has minimal logging, making it hard to debug issues during batch runs.

## What

- Add structured logging to orchestrate.py
- Log executor state transitions
- Include timing information for each step
- Write logs to `.lanegate/logs/orchestrate.jsonl` with machine-readable format

## Close Criteria

- Logging outputs JSON to `.lanegate/logs/` directory
- Each step includes timestamp and duration
- No performance impact on orchestration runs
close_criteria: Logging outputs JSON to `.lanegate/logs/` directory; each step includes timestamp and duration; no performance impact on orchestration runs
review_summary: Awaiting review from the on-call reviewer
